dead-letter:archive-q.title: order-archive has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:archive-q.message: If Archive orders can't handle a message, it's dropped after 3 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:archive-q.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.

no-reader:dlq.title: Dead letters pile up in fulfillment-orders-dlq
no-reader:dlq.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on fulfillment-orders-dlq: failed messages stay there until someone looks.
no-reader:dlq.rationale: A dead-letter queue has no automatic cleanup. Someone should be told when messages land there, and be able to replay them.
